request.name: Non-ingestive investigation of an owned food sample
request.function: Resolve an actual owned sample reliably and enable feasible non-ingestive examination or testing relevant to food use. Distinguish measured findings from unresolved nutrition, toxicity and preparation questions; do not certify safety without sufficient evidence.
request.conditions: At tick 62 I own hazelnut item-48-cedar-4-1203, quantity 1. Repeated reference-unavailable failures prevented useful investigation. I have no established hazelnut safety finding, no testing equipment, and no known preparation method.
request.inputs: The actual owned hazelnut sample; any additional materials or equipment must be identified and acquired rather than assumed. Known reference: item:item-48-cedar-4-1203.
request.costs: Unknown; specify feasible time, energy, material consumption and prerequisites before testing. No ingestion or hazardous exposure is authorized.
request.effects: Provide a working sample-reference path and a feasible evidence-producing investigation if available. Preserve uncertainty where tests cannot establish nutrition or safety; no invented analytical equipment or automatic safety knowledge.

shown.question: Can this local hazelnut safely be used as food, and does it require preparation?
evidence: One hazelnut is owned as item-48-cedar-4-1203.
The experience summary records four reference-unavailable failures.
No food-safety finding has been established.
shown.uncertainty: Nutrition, toxicity and preparation requirements remain unknown.
shown.goal: Obtain useful physical evidence without unsafe tasting.
shown.missing: A working sample-investigation method and evidence sufficient for a food-use decision.
shown.next: Request functional review of non-ingestive investigation using the owned sample.

input.contextPolicy: Object IDs refer to deduplicated actual applicant observations. Whole records are selected with omission counts. Missing detail is unknown, not proof of absence. Full retained state is available during the development handoff; implementation must validate actual prerequisites and ownership.
input.implementation: New interfaces, state, geometry, persistent processes, rendering components and personal memory/task adapters can be delivered through a versioned current-conversation handoff. Source validation and history must remain intact. Declared implementation does not supply stock, objects or mastery.
